summary: A write that holds the store's writer for more than 1 s logs one line naming its holder, how long it held the writer and how long it waited

replay.detail: No claim, projection or cache changes; nothing is replayed or rebuilt.

schema.detail: No table, index, view, trigger or storage version changes.

rules.detail: Writes commit exactly as before; only a log line is added after a long hold ends.

compatibility.detail: No wire, client or stored-format change. The new WARN line carries holder (the request route or daemon task), client (the caller), at (the code location that asked), kind (batch or lend), held_ms, waited_ms, writes and stages.

recovery.detail: Rolling back removes the log line; nothing else changes.
